content: <@586161934425128960> I tested nflaig/lodestar:clear-builder-payments-on-slash with the 5 node test. The builder saw A first; the honest validators saw the self-slashing B first, and B finalized without a payload. B carried a positive 0.101 ETH bid, but all five Lodestar nodes cleared its pending payment, and no corresponding withdrawal occurred at settlement. Your fix prevented the payment-loss path.
